idea: Short clip #1 of the Friday long song 'Bubble on My Nose!' (JIMMY'S ROOM): the opening hook – a rainbow soap bubble pops onto Baby Jimmy's nose ('Pop! Oh, wow! A bubble on my nose!') – the first chorus 'Nose and ears, tummy and toes!' and the nose verse ('This is my nose! Touch your nose with me! Boop, boop, boop! Sniff, sniff, sniff!'). Learning: body part NOSE (+ chorus nose, ears, tummy, toes); copy-me touch your nose.
title: Pop! A Bubble on My Nose! 👃 Touch Your Nose with Baby Jimmy | Learn Body Parts | Crayon Babies
description:
Pop! A shiny soap bubble lands right on Baby Jimmy's nose! 👃 Touch your nose with Baby Jimmy in his cozy bedroom and sing the body parts chorus: nose and ears, tummy and toes!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Pop! Oh, wow! A bubble on my nose!"
🎵 Sing the chorus – nose and ears, tummy and toes!
👃 "This is my nose!" – touch your nose with Jimmy: boop, boop, boop!
👃 Nose, nose, nose! Sniff, sniff, sniff!

📚 Kids learn: body parts • nose • English words: nose, touch, sniff • chorus words: nose, ears, tummy, toes

A fun sing-along body parts clip for toddlers and preschoolers – touch your nose, boop, boop, boop, and sing along with Baby Jimmy to learn body parts in English.
